headline: Lenders review exposure to Shrivana Textile Mills as orders slow
body: Two banks are reviewing their exposure to Shrivana Textile Mills after the Tiruppur knitwear maker asked for longer credit on its working-capital lines, people familiar with the matter said. Export orders from two European retailers were cut this quarter.

headline: Brightwell Home Retail scales back, closing 14 stores across the Midwest
body: Brightwell Home Retail Inc. said it is scaling back its store network, closing 14 locations by January as same-store sales fell for a third straight quarter.

headline: Hessler Maschinenbau has fallen behind on payments to suppliers
body: Stuttgart machine builder Hessler Maschinenbau GmbH has fallen behind on payments to several component suppliers, three of them told a regional business paper, after a large customer postponed acceptance of two production lines.
